BatchSendMessageToGlobe.description_en: Sends a message to multiple recipients in countries or regions outside the Chinese mainland
BatchSendMessageToGlobe.description_zh: 批量发送短信到中国境外

ConversionData.description_en: Reports the status of an OTP message to Alibaba Cloud SMS
ConversionData.description_zh: 将短信转化率统计数据反馈给阿里云国际短信平台

QueryMessage.description_en: Queries the delivery report of a message
QueryMessage.description_zh: 使用短信MessageId查询短信发送记录

SendMessageToGlobe.description_en: Sends messages to regions outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), Taiwan (China)
SendMessageToGlobe.description_zh: 发送短信到中国香港、中国澳门、中国台湾以及中国境外地区

SendMessageWithTemplate.description_en: Sends a message to the Chinese mainland by using a message template
SendMessageWithTemplate.description_zh: 使用短信模板发送短信，只支持发往中国内地

SmsConversion.description_en: Delivers one-time password (OTP) message statuses to Alibaba Cloud, which calculates and monitors OTP conversion rates
SmsConversion.description_zh: 将每一条消息ID(MessageId) 对应短信的接收情况反馈给阿里云国际短信平台
